scenes.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape inline story illustration for the graded-reader story “The Three Little Pigs”
Primary request: show the end of paragraph 1: the youngest pig carefully lays bricks one at a time while his two older brothers laugh at his slow work.
Scene/backdrop: a simple clearing at the edge of a green forest, with a small neat stack of red-orange bricks in front and a few straw bundles and wooden branches off to the sides.
Subject: exactly three friendly pink piglets. The youngest wears a cream shirt and rust-orange overalls and concentrates on setting one brick into a low wall. His brothers wear cream shirts with simple blue and muted-green overalls, standing nearby and smiling at how long the work is taking. Use the story cover only for these character identities and clothing colours.
Style/medium: gentle children's picture-book painting in the approved Kasa Jizō inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal surface texture, a few purposeful folds and shadows, simplified quiet background; distinctly simpler than the textured cover.
Composition/framing: landscape about 12:7 for the reader, medium-wide, with the bricklaying pig as the clear focal subject and the two brothers secondary, two or three broad depth layers.
Lighting/mood: warm clear afternoon, industrious and lightly playful.
Color palette: warm ivory, soft sky blue, sage and muted teal, restrained terracotta, natural pink.
Constraints: exactly three pigs; depict steady bricklaying before any wolf arrives. No lettering, title, border, frame, or watermark.
Avoid: wolf, completed house, danger, violence, extra animals, text, photorealism, glossy 3D, dense brush texture, highly detailed background.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape inline story illustration for the graded-reader story “The Three Little Pigs”
Primary request: illustrate the end of paragraph 2, when all three pigs have run to the sturdy brick house after the wolf destroys the straw and wooden houses.
Input images: Image 1 is the story cover, for the three pigs’ character identities and clothing colours only; Images 2–4 are approved Kasa Jizō inline paintings, for their broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours and quiet simplicity only.
Scene/backdrop: a simple forest clearing with the strong brick house in the foreground and the broken straw and twig houses small and distant.
Subject: exactly three friendly pink piglets with small dark eyes and simple natural faces. Match the cover’s clothing colours: first pig in muted blue overalls, second in sage green, youngest in rust-orange overalls, all with cream shirts. They are safe together at the brick house doorway. One hungry wolf stands outside at a comfortable distance after blowing the flimsy houses apart; the pigs are unharmed and there is no contact.
Style/medium: gentle picture-book painting in the approved Kasa Jizō inline treatment: broad mostly smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal surface texture, only a few purposeful folds and shadows, and a quiet simplified background. Keep detail simpler than the textured cover.
Composition/framing: landscape about 12:7 for the reader, medium-wide, brick house and three pigs as the clear focal group, wolf secondary, two or three calm depth layers.
Lighting/mood: warm daylight, tense but safe and reassuring.
Color palette: warm ivory, muted blue, sage, restrained terracotta, soft green and natural pink.
Constraints: exactly three pigs and one wolf; depict only events already told by paragraph 2. Keep everyone safe. No lettering, title, border, frame or watermark.
Avoid: injury, violence, frightening expressions, wolf touching or chasing a pig, extra animals, text, photorealism, glossy 3D, dense brush texture, detailed background.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape inline story illustration for the graded-reader story “The Three Little Pigs”
Primary request: illustrate the chimney scene from paragraph 3 without showing anyone hurt.
Input images: Image 1 is the story cover, for the three pigs’ character identities and clothing colours only; Images 2–4 are approved Kasa Jizō inline paintings, for their broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours and quiet simplicity only.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet forest clearing and the strong brick house, with a simple open cutaway view of one room and the roof chimney.
Subject: exactly three friendly pink piglets with small dark eyes and simple natural faces. Match the cover’s clothing colours: first pig in muted blue overalls, second in sage green, youngest in rust-orange overalls, all with cream shirts. Inside, the youngest tends a large pot as a soft cloud of harmless steam rises. On the roof beside the chimney, a single startled wolf turns away and bounds toward the forest, completely unharmed and with no contact with the pot or steam. The two older brothers watch safely from inside.
Style/medium: gentle picture-book painting in the approved Kasa Jizō inline treatment: broad mostly smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal surface texture, only a few purposeful folds and shadows, and a quiet simplified background. Keep detail simpler than the textured cover.
Composition/framing: landscape about 12:7 for the reader, medium-wide, with the youngest pig and pot inside and the wolf outside as two readable parts of one simple composition, two or three broad depth layers.
Lighting/mood: warm, reassuring and lightly playful.
Color palette: warm ivory, muted blue, sage, restrained terracotta, soft green and natural pink.
Constraints: exactly three pigs and one wolf; depict only events already told by paragraph 3. Keep everyone safe. No lettering, title, border, frame or watermark.
Avoid: burning or boiling anyone, injury, violence, direct contact, frightening expressions, extra animals, text, photorealism, glossy 3D, dense brush texture, highly detailed background.
